Hello! My name is Mittali Singh, a rookie programmer. Pros: curious and adaptive learner, and an applicant of Riga Technical University. Mission: to create sustainable technology while providing digital literacy to underprivileged children.
Number Theory and Explorations: a dependency-free Python library exploring prime numbers, modular arithmetic and number theory. Pixelled-lofi-Spotify: cotton candy beats is a pastel pixellated Spotify clone; album covers are generated pixel sprites, not images. Planet Simulation: a 2D gravitational simulation of the inner solar system using Newton's and Kepler's law. Sudoku Solver: a pastel themed sudoku solver (sample and random generated), used by Python and tkinter.
Pehchaan - The Street School. Photos from donation drives and time spent teaching and volunteering with the children there.
Excerpts: Icarus — according to some Greek mythologies Icarus flew too close to sun. My pretty girl — blessed the cigarette pressed between her lips. The art — the art we created, the bond we formed. Dialogue — please don't do this to me, please don't pull me into being a wretch again.
Thank you for following through. Signing off, Mittali Singh.

some of my writings

a few pieces, in full

Icarus

According to some greek mythologies icarus flew too close to the sun for his love and affinity for him. i used to chuckle at the mere thought of someone being stupid enough to burn themselves cause they love someone so much, but then my darling lover you came in my life i was very precautious at first i always knew when to stop flying and come back to ground but with your frivolous smile everything got lost for me i was in magellanic clouds in a smitten haze and you steadily crept towards me and lightly hugged me with carver in other hand you meticulously opened my dermis and licked on the blood and fitted yourself in me and then intertwined us, you threaded our layers together with a pink thread and now honey whatever our souls are made up of they are the same. my dream has beffalen upon me to smell like you till eternity, now forever cries upon our feet for it cant do us apart. -mittali singh

My pretty girl

bless the cigarette that was pressed between her lips. how lucky that roll of paper must have been that it made an acquaintance with them. oh! those luscious plum lips they are a fever dream of mankind. she sends people into a spiral if she merely smiles. she is mine she doesn't know that yet but i do i will do everything to tear her lip apart gently and meticulously with the tip of my fingers and slurp the juice out of them and it still won't be quite enough cause i love her so much i will be still in such an agony after slurping on her blood so i will find a way to get under her skin to suck the marrow out of her life nd then i will thread our soul together so she never leaves me. then the world will see her as a dainty haunting mess, but she will be all mine. she wreaks havoc in my life via her presence the least i can do is feast on her dermis and make her all mine. -mittali singh

The art

he art we created, the bond we formed whilst we were washing the paint off of our hands i dont really want salvation after it. when i told him it was as really therapuetic session we should do this again sometimes he looked at me as if i had gigantic tentacles growing on myself and with utter disbelief belief smeared across his face he stormed towards me pinned me against the wall his grip tightening on my throat he spat what the hell are you talking about you crazy woman we just murdered someone and don’t you dare to even whisper a word about this to even your wall, dropped me, stormed off. MURDER he says, what we did was bond, what we did was love making cleping that activity as murder is a disrespect to all three of us; me, him and the corpse. Corpse was certainly not the victim he was the middleman of our love story he was the one who tightened our bond together. When we were dragging middleman by the hair our pinkies touched, it sent and elctrifying jolt in my body made me drag the man with much more force to show my lover how capable how loyal i am towards him, very first step of bonding in a relationship-I passed that step! For him, i would love him if he chopped my leg off with an axe there was no need for him to pass on any steps of bonding or love making, he is perfect in every form. And when I plunged the knife through my sweet middleman’s heart and the blood went in my eye blinding me, he came and wiped my eyes showing me how caring, how loving he is towards me. When he was successful enough to get the blood out of my eyes we stood there first we eyed each other and then he pulled me by my waist and made love right in the blood of our beautiful middleman so slow delightful and heavenly, or maybe it was one of my reveries but if it was was what would explain my blood soaked skirt? So we did made love we did bond the spatter of the blood was the tool me and the room was canvas my lover painted me tainted me so beautifully and room was adorned by our art(the splatter of blood on the walls on my face across his face) all of it was art to call it a murder is nothing but a crime. Now our magnum opus has been made and mr loverman left me heaving on the floor with the corpse and there’s no souvenir of our love making so i make one myself i lick the blood of the wall and the floors and chew on the axe where his hands touched, human behavior is unpredictable my heart aches from the mere thought of me forgetting this moment so i solidify it and chomp on the corpse and get to the entrails and i sniff it, lick it bite it in hope that if i never drink water again i will always carry the taste of me and my loverman’s bond. But what if my taste buds betray me? What if i stop feeling the taste? I think surely nothing will happen to my eyes they have been healthiest part of my body all the health checkups are the proof so i take a scapel and gauge my eye out of the socket and pour the blood in my retinas, but my eyes! can betray me aswell who knows so I reach in the temporal lobe and take hippocampus in my hand my run it over the corpse get all the blood on it and now even if all the powers of universe aligned together to make me forget this memory I WONT FORGET IT cause i have it plastered on my brain, what the universe gonna do? Go beyond science? -mittali singh

Dialogue

please don't do this to me! Don't plunge me into being a wretch again! oh love, but don't you feel good, perhaps congenial? That mind-numbing period of your life. when you sit alone, cry and it feels good. Young lady, you are ever so often saying "Crying makes you feel good". Now, for you shan't run come sit with me and discern the hideous facets this world has to offer. Most certainly, your petite outburst will not blunt this grotesque actuality that we soberly cleped life. -mittali singh
